scope.sample: one accepted baseline and one complete matched control; no confidence interval or production capacity proof
scope.rates: fleet aggregate logical workload cycles, ordinary data RPCs, metadata RPCs and all acknowledgements reported separately; open/close are metadata; truncate is metadata; idle liveness excluded
scope.metric_files: 352 hash-bound active before/after files per run; eleven processes,16cells; sequential process cuts are not globally atomic
scope.async_wall: inclusive await elapsed; nested/concurrent overlap, not exclusive CPU or sum of waits
scope.cpu: frontend process deltas include observers/background, not backend CPU or a pure active-only CPU interval
scope.fresh_oracle: two full controller-backend context/reopen passes across everyDrive, not everyworker; each run final byte count matches its own expected receipts
scope.source: provider compiled proof is accepted build source+Cargo emitted binary+terminal/worker digest join; unchanged native harness digest alone is insufficient
